summary: The prepared source retained the inclusive target-only acceptance predicate. The patch requires positive target mass and uses a strict half-open CDF comparison, with native-kernel regression cases for zero mass, threshold-zero, interior boundaries, and both RNG endpoints. Two open upstream PRs independently contain the same correction. Source checks pass, but this gfx950 ROCm environment's installed sgl_kernel does not register the target-only AOT operator, so the modified native kernel could not be rebuilt or executed here.

tests.what_was_measured: Attempted the issue's synthetic DFlash path on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X; it stopped before sampler execution with RuntimeError: DFLASH non-greedy verification is unavailable on this build/device.
Confirmed the installed ROCm sgl_kernel lacks torch.ops.sgl_kernel.tree_speculative_sampling_target_only; both pre-existing native tests fail at operator lookup before GPU kernel launch.
Collected all seven focused tests, including five independent CDF boundary scenarios.
Repository formatting, syntax, lint, and policy checks passed for the changed native source and regression test.

gpu_execution_evidence: torch.cuda identified one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), and the DFlash setup allocated GPU tensors, but DFlash rejected non-greedy verification on this build and the installed sgl_kernel 0.4.6.post1 did not register the target-only operator. Therefore no issue-specific native kernel execution is claimed.
remaining_limitations: The CUDA-oriented AOT sgl_kernel build has no prepared ROCm native rebuild path in this checkout, and its CMake project requires CUDA; the modified native library was not built on gfx950.
DFlash and EAGLE/MTP caller-level behavior was not executed because the shared target-only native operator is unavailable on this ROCm installation.
No full model, model weights, semantic-accuracy workload, or distributed workload was run or claimed.
